role: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil designer, land development (Geelong)
subject: Graduate civil enquiry for Loetis in Geelong, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Tom,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. I found your details on the Loetis about page and wanted to write to you directly, since your work centres on roads, drainage, sewer and water design.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

Loetis designs subdivisions from 2 lots to estates of more than 2,000 lots, along with road, drainage and sewer upgrades for councils, which is the kind of civil design work I want to learn on. My software experience is from study, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Would you be open to a short conversation about any graduate civil role at Loetis in Geelong?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
